test_title: PYST 75: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in active voice.

The novels of Dickens are being read by Mayank.

options.text: Mayank is reading the novels of Dickens.
Mayank has been reading the novels of Dickens.
Mayank was reading the novels of Dickens.
Mayank had been reading the novels of Dickens.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The novels of Dickens are being read by Mayank."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "Mayank" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "are being read" to "is reading" (present continuous active).
 
• Ensure the object "the novels of Dickens" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mayank is reading the novels of Dickens."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"Mayank has been reading the novels of Dickens." – This indicates a different tense (present perfect continuous).
 
• **Option 3: **"Mayank was reading the novels of Dickens." – This is the past continuous tense.
 
• **Option 4: **"Mayank had been reading the novels of Dickens." – This indicates the past perfect continuous tense.
